summary.adminsHint: Platform admins with a verified e-mail{twoFactor, select, yes { and two-factor} other {}} who can approve.
summary.fourEyesOn: Four eyes: a second platform admin approves your requests.
summary.fourEyesOff: You are the only approving admin: your own requests are self-approved and need a ticket reference.
summary.noAdmins: No platform admin can approve at the moment.

rules.readOnly: Every grant is read-only: the tenant's dashboard refuses changes, and the database transaction is read-only too.
rules.audited: Every request, approval, revocation and every page view under a grant is recorded in the organisation's audit log with the grant id.
rules.notified: The organisation's owners are e-mailed on approval and when an active grant is revoked.

request.title: Request access
request.text: Read-only access to one organisation for a limited time. A platform admin approves; the clock starts at approval.
request.organizationHint: {count, plural, =0 {No organisations yet} one {# organisation} other {# organisations}}, sorted by name.
request.reasonHint: At least {min} characters: what you need to see and why — the customer's report, the ticket context.
request.ticketHint: For example SUP-1234. Required when you approve your own request (single-admin fallback).

queue.title: Approval queue
queue.caption: Open break-glass requests
queue.emptyText: Requests wait here until a platform admin approves or declines them.
queue.fourEyesBlocked: Another platform admin has to approve your own request (four eyes).
queue.ticketRequired: Self-approval needs a ticket reference: withdraw the request and file it again with one.
queue.selfApprovalHint: No other admin can approve: this approval is recorded as self-approved.

approveDialog.title: Approve read-only access?
approveDialog.description: {name} gets read-only access to {organization} for {duration}, starting now. The organisation's owners are e-mailed and every page view is recorded with the grant id.

declineDialog.title: Decline this request?
declineDialog.description: The request by {name} for {organization} is closed without access. The decision is recorded in the audit log.

withdrawDialog.title: Withdraw your request?
withdrawDialog.description: Your request for {organization} is closed without access. You can file a new one at any time.

active.title: Active grants
active.caption: Currently active break-glass grants
active.emptyText: Nobody has read-only access to a customer organisation right now.
active.notNotified: Owners not e-mailed — check the mail transport

revokeDialog.title: Revoke access now?
revokeDialog.description: The grant for {organization} ends immediately; the operator loses access with the next request and the owners are e-mailed.

history.title: History
history.caption: Closed, expired and revoked break-glass entries
history.emptyText: Closed requests, expired and revoked grants appear here.
history.truncated: Only the most recent entries are shown; the complete trail is in the audit log.

notices.requested: Request filed. A platform admin has to approve it.
notices.approved: Access approved; the grant is active now.
notices.notified: {sent, plural, =0 {No owner was e-mailed} one {# owner e-mailed} other {# owners e-mailed}}{failed, plural, =0 {} one {, # delivery failed} other {, # deliveries failed}}.
